BOTTOM LIFT 01 LAND AT BOTTOM OF SHAFT
CLIENT ONLY - Fly By while MiddleIn2
if you do damage to Omega play this!!

int.text: We can't hurt him at ALL? How are we supposed to BEAT him?
Uh, Megatron...
Wow...he looks REALLY angry.

fra.text: Ouah... il a vraiment l'air furieux.

int.text: Speaking of Omega Supreme...
HAHAHAHA! He's going down! Eat THAT, rust-for-brains!
Megatron -- all due respect, but are you CRAZY? If we go out there, he'll melt us into scrap!
There's Omega Supreme! Watch out...
We're not going to make it!
It's no use, Megatron! The door's locked!
I don't like it.  It's too quiet.  Why the cease-fire?
Omega Supreme's right on our tails! There's got to be some way to shake him!
A dead end! Megatron, we're trapped!
I don't like it, Megatron.  It's too quiet.

fra.text: C'est trop calme. On devrait se méfier.

int.text: We made it! I can't believe it! WE MADE IT!

fra.text: On a réussi ! J'arrive pas à le croire ! J'AI RÉUSSI !!

int.text: Look out! Sentries above us!

fra.text: Attention ! Des gardiens, au-dessus de nous !

int.text: TAKE COVER! He's gonna fire the big gun!

fra.text: À COUVERT ! Son gros canon va ouvrir le feu !

int.text: He's hurt! It's working! Keep pouring it on with the turrets!
HEADS UP! Aerialbots, coming this way!

fra.text: ATTENTION ! Des Aérobots viennent par ici !

int.text: What's wrong with this thing?  Why can't we get it to move?
We're still alive? We're still alive!! ...What happened?
These guys don't know when to quit, do they?

fra.text: Ces abrutis ne s'avouent jamais vaincus, ma parole.

int.text: I don't like it.  Omega's just waiting for us out there!
HahaHAA! Did you see me back there? Omega couldn't touch me!

fra.text: Ah, ah, ah ! Vous avez vu ça !? Je suis trop rapide pour ce gros tas de rouille !

int.text: Watch out! Omega's mining the road ahead!

fra.text: Attention ! Omega est en train de miner le terrain !

int.text: You want us to go through that power conduit? No way! The energon flow is off the charts, we'll be fried!
Did you see that? Those Autobots were CLOAKED!
One ugly Autobot, straight ahead.

fra.text: Je vais m'occuper de ce Ravageur.

int.text: Autobot Brute incoming!
Look at that Brute. Guess we can't ALL be beautiful.
Heads up! Got a Brute straight ahead!

fra.text: Attention, un Ravageur se ramène par ici !

int.text: I thought Zeta said it was gonna come to US!
It's coming right at us!
We're gonna dieeeeeee!
He's gone!  What is this guy?  You think he knows about the Omega Key?
What are we gonna do NOW, Megatron?
We can't fight this thing! We've gotta get out of here!
That did it, all right -- but there goes your Omega Key!
Now what?  How are we gonna beat this guy, Megatron?
Uh-oh...  Here he comes!
AAAAAAAA!!!
He's trying to grab us!
Another elevator?  I don't know... the last one didn't work out so well.
We're pinned down!
Omega found us again!  We can't go that way... what do we do now?!?
Heads up!  More mines!
Is Omega still out there?  Did we lose him?

fra.text: Omega est toujours là ? Est-ce qu'on l'a semé ?

int.text: Guess not.
Looks like the Autobots are still using these guns, Megatron.  Our Seekers are getting shredded.
Enemy rockets! Comin' in fast!
Are we making any progress at all here? I can't tell!

fra.text: Notre tactique fonctionne, ou pas ? Difficile à dire !!

int.text: That all you got, you floating junk-pile?!?  Come on!!!
We must return to the door!

fra.text: On doit retourner à la porte !

int.text: He's gonna blast us if we don't get out of here!

fra.text: Il va tous nous atomiser si on reste ici !

int.text: Move out of the tube, or you'll get fried!

fra.text: Sortez de la conduite ou vous allez griller !

int.text: YEAH! That's showing him!
We gotta take out those repair sentries!

fra.text: On doit éliminer ces robots réparateurs !

int.text: There's Omega again!  He's getting ahead of us!

fra.text: Revoilà Omega Supreme ! Il nous passe devant !

int.text: Decepticon!
I will destroy you!
Heads up, Decepticons!
We got company boys!
Watch out, Decepticons!
Here comes trouble!
Let's go, Decepticon!
Decepticons Ahead!
Sound the alarm!
Decepticons inbound!
Stay sharp! We've got company!
Death RX 5
Decepticons, inbound!
Omega Supreme has lost the Decepticons!  Where'd they go?

fra.text: Omega Supreme a perdu les Decepticons ! On ne sait plus où ils sont !

int.text: What's going on?!?
Target the Seekers! Get those Decepticons out of the sky!
Death RX 12
Scan this entire sector!  Find them!
Someone's breaking in!  Assume defensive positions!
We can't let the Decepticons take control of these turrets!  Stop them, Autobots!
Death RX 2
Megatron -- you're still functional! Thank Primus we found you!

fra.text: Megatron ! Tu es toujours opérationnel ! On commençait à désespérer !

int.text: AAAAAAAA!!!
FALL BACK! Fall back and take cover!
Megatron! Help us -- MEGATRONNNNN...!
He's got me!  I can't break free!
Let's get them!
Death RX 2
Fall back.  Inside.  Quickly!
Stop wasting ammunition. We will find another way to deal with Omega Supreme.
Starscream, you halfwit! I still function...a fact you shall regret, when I choke the life out of you! Now -- I order you to deploy ships for immediate evacuation!
Grrr! Let's head for that lift, before that idiot Starscream causes irreparable harm.
Starscream -- come in. This is Megatron.
Can this feeble Autobot mechanism not move any faster?!?
It appears we've lost that dull-witted brute, Omega Supreme.  Not that he stood a chance against my intellect.
What? WHAT?
Starscream, do you read me?
Spare me your theatrics!  I need immediate air support! Attack Omega Supreme!
Would you rather face his wrath, or mine?  Now jump!
Faster, Decepticons!
You WILL reach the other side, or I'll have your head!
Starscream! Status report!
BELAY THAT ORDER! Decepticons, this is MEGATRON! Anyone caught fleeing this battle will be marked kill on sight! Press your attack IMMEDIATELY!
Especially you, Starscream! I order you to continue the assault! Megatron out!
An excellent idea, Soundwave.
Autobots! Decepticons -- open fire!
Soundwave! You led us to this place. What is your explanation?
You heard him! Blast the wall!

fra.text: Il fallait le dire ! Explosez ce mur !

int.text: And yet still preferable to your incessant chatter. Now get to those controls!
Finally. Decepticons -- move quickly. We must reach those guns!
I can see that, you fool!
Yes, Breakdown, your constant whining saw us through.
Omega Supreme's main weapon batteries are charging! Prepare for evasive action!
Keep firing, Decepticons!  The turrets are wearing down Omega Supreme's defenses!
Decepticons! Omega Supreme has deployed Aerialbots! Shoot them down!
A simple solution, then.  Break the locks!
You think you can destroy me, Omega Supreme? You think you can destroy MEGATRON? ...Do your worst.
Open fire on the emergency locks! Destroy them!

fra.text: Tirez sur les verrous de sécurité ! Détruisez-les !

int.text: A futile gesture. Decepticons! Destroy the sentries!
Do not test me, Breakdown. My patience is at a critical low.
Stop whining and start shooting, Breakdown!
Excellent work, Soundwave. Now unlock the exit door.
Then I suggest you move quickly! Now go!
Smash through them!
Get moving, Breakdown!
Activate the bridge!
Precisely as I had planned. Decepticons! Man the turrets, and blast that obsolete hulk out of the sky!
Maintain this heading!  The device shows the Omega Key is directly ahead!
Stay your course!
Turn around and--where did it go?
No, Breakdown. He IS the Omega Key!
Silence! This merely modifies my plan. If Omega Supreme IS the key...then I shall FORCE him to open the planet's core.
Starscream!  I am 7 clicks north of your position!
Enough!  Meet us at the bridge!
Starscream, you COWARD!
Stand your ground, Decepticons! Destroy the bridge supports!

fra.text: Tenez vos positions, Decepticons ! Détruisez les supports du pont !

int.text: We can salvage the wreckage for what we need.
Lock the door!  Quickly!
I see...  We will lure Omega Supreme up there, and use the Autobot guns against him!
Autobot weaklings.  Onward, to the lift!
Keep moving, Decepticons!  We need to reach that lift!

fra.text: Avancez, Decepticons ! Nous devons atteindre ce monte-charge !

int.text: Move back inside!  Perhaps we can avoid Omega's tracking systems.
They must be coordinating with Omega Supreme, trying to locate us.  Well, we'll give them what they want... along with a painful death!
There, Omega Supreme is distracted!  Attack the Autobots!
Move quickly!  The bridge terminal is just ahead!
Let's get off this road and out of the open.  We will find another way!
Perfect. We shall ascend, and Omega Supreme will follow...to his destruction.
More cloaked Autobots!  Destroy them!  Shoot anything that moves!
We've reached the ion turrets.  Now--let Omega Supreme come!
Blast the Autobots and take those guns!
Homing rockets!  Take cover!
Attack, Decepticons!  We defeat Omega Supreme here or we die trying!
Your power is failing, Omega.  Soon you shall bend to my will!
I gave you an order!  Fall back NOW!
Move faster, Decepticons!
Out of the energy tube!  Now!
Omega flees like a coward!  Now--let's finish the job!
Target the repair sentries, or we'll never destroy these Autobots!
Target: re-acquired.  Weapons: engaging.
Targets: re-acquired.  Attack: commencing.  Decepticons: prepare for destruction.
Identification: Decepticons.  Action: Terminate.
Detecting: small arms fire.  Analysis: minor annoyance.
Primary weapon: charging.
Target identification: Megatron, Decepticon leader.  Recommendation: complete termination.
Identity: Omega Supreme. Enemy status: TERMINATED.
Target: Acquired.  Mission: Destroy.
New targets: Acquired.  Initiating:  Pursuit.

fra.text: Nouvelles cibles : confirmées. Action en cours : poursuite.

int.text: Decepticons:  Located.
Rockets: Activated.
Omega Supreme's armor is too thick for our weapons.
Megatron. I am receiving a Decepticon transmission.
Starscream cannot hear you, Megatron. All communication to the surface has been jammed.
There is too much interference. We must move higher to relay your signal.

fra.text: Il y a trop d'interférences. Attends encore un peu avant de transmettre ton signal.

int.text: Megatron -- analysis indicates the firepower of those turrets is sufficient to damage Omega Supreme.
Megatron -- I detect numerous Decepticon and Autobot signals a few dozen meters above us. We are nearing the surface battle.
Suggestion: Use Dark Energon to open the door.
Scans reveal poor structural integrity surrounding this maintenance access door.
The bridge is just ahead. It may be necessary to extend the tube by accessing the bridge controls.
The bridge is extended. We now have access to the other side.
Megatron -- scanners indicate a bridge nearby. Crossing there will give us access to a second elevator.
Warning! Sensors indicate Omega Supreme is powering up his primary beam weapon!
Megatron -- Omega Supreme's armor has been breached.
Megatron -- sensors indicate Autobot fliers incoming.
The elevator is locked down.
Megatron, the Autobot security systems are countering the effects of Dark Energon.

fra.text: Megatron, les systèmes de sécurité Autobots tentent de contrer les effets de l'énergon noir.

int.text: This lift will provide passage to the surface when activated.

fra.text: Une fois activé, ce monte-charge nous emmènera jusqu'à la surface.

int.text: Fortified Autobot position located straight ahead. Jamming Autobot scanners now. Our approach should be undetected.
Omega Supreme approaches!
Megatron -- these are Iacon power maintenance tunnels. Moving through them will lead to the bridge terminal.
We are being intercepted!
Megatron -- there is a Decepticon dropship across the bridge. They appear to be scanning for survivors.
Our weapons are ineffective.
During our approach to this sector, my scanners detected ion cannons near the top of the chasm wall.
Mapping alternate route now.
Megatron -- the second cargo elevator is nearby. It will take us directly to the heavy ion turrets.
Caution:  We are being tracked by multiple explosive projectiles.
According to my calculations, our chances of defeating Omega Supreme are... very low.
Scanners indicate Omega Supreme's power levels are dropping.
The bridge is rapidly disintegrating.
Omega Supreme is closing on us, Megatron.
Caution: any contact with the energy beams will cause severe systems damage.
Tube temperature will soon be fatal.

fra.text: La température ambiante sera bientôt fatale.

int.text: The automated repair systems are healing the enemy units.
To all Decepticons who fight for the glory of Cybertron! Megatron has fallen!  I, Starscream, have taken my rightful place as your leader!
Megatron?  You're alive?
The Autobots are counter-attacking!  Retreat!  Decepticons, retreat!
Attack?  But Megatron -
Death RX 1
Come in, Megatron!  This is Starscream, do you read me?
Megatron! I watched you crash and burn...
I, uh, I'll go get help, Megatron!
